reason: I only pay when the thing is in my hand. A new page asking me to send the item price up front and then wait three weeks is exactly how people I know lost their money, even if the stock from China would be good for my shop.
objection: I pay first to a service I've never heard of, then wait 2 to 3 weeks hoping it shows up and isn't fake or wrong. A photo from a warehouse doesn't prove anything to me, and a refund promise from a new business is just words.
would_change_my_mind: Let me pay everything cash on delivery, at least for the first order, or let me see a real shop or office and people I know who got their orders.
